sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You will find it difficult to keep up appearances. Be prepared, says Ganesha. Situations are likely to bring out your inner feelings, your true nature. If someone crosses or confronts you will neither take it lying down, nor be inclined to forget and forgive. Maintain your composure and don’t allow anyone to hassle or provoke you. Later, you will get out of this mood and remain cheerful and lively for the rest of the day.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Your mind might be stimulated today, Taurus, so stay alert and open to new information. If you feel tired, take a short nap. It's better to operate at top speed and full capacity than go through your day only half present. Don't rely on external stimulants like caffeine to pick you up. These things will deceive your body and do damage to your nervous system.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Allow past disappointments, hurt feelings, or fears to fuel your next moves. Though these issues may have weighed you down up until this point, now is your moment to alchemize pain into success. Focus on a singular project or goal, funneling energy that's built up into these agendas. The Capricorn Moon helps you gain wisdom along the way, aligning with Neptune to heal wounds and provide enlightenment. Cap off your day with a soothing self-care session when Luna aspects Venus rx.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Don't hesitate to express your views. Let not allow confidence deficiency take over you as it will only complicate your problem and could retard your progress. Today, you will understand the importance of money and how unnecessarily spending it can negatively affect your future. Today you should concentrate on the needs of others but being extra generous with children will only lead to trouble. You could ruin your project if you are too open about your plans. Unexpected travel for some proves to be hectic and stressful. Your plans might get disturbed due to an unexpected guest, but it will make your day.

readings.text: In the morning, you may come across adverse circumstances that may hamper your progress. However, in the evening you will be more focused and thus you will gain back lost confidence. Nothing may bother you thereafter. You are likely to be satisfied with your productivity.

Today you could feel eager to impress someone. Maybe there is someone you work with who is especially important and could support you in your career. Today you should have some success in putting your best foot forward. It's a great day to make friends and influence people.

bits.t: Focus on a singular project or goal, funneling energy that's built up into these agendas.
You could ruin your project if you are too open about your plans.

readings.text: Although money matters a lot to you, scope of you being able to think about it seriously is very less during the first half of the day. You will be thinking about your image, but not about money.

This week is about your home, which may mean having to spend more to get good quality goods or an emergency plumber to fix a broken sink. Whatever the case, know that it's going to be better soon. Meanwhile, a supportive aspect transforms your dreams. Don't give up on that wild scheme yet. It may yield results soon.

readings.text: While you are going to be very busy and will be investing lot of energy in everything you do, you may need more energy as the day progresses. However, you will hardly have any energy left in the second half of the day, says Ganesha.

You are happy at the center of attention, but when change is afoot you prefer to hang in the background. With today's planetary alignment, your mind will be catching up with your feelings, trying to figure out what it is that you really want. Don't push yourself to be too social these next couple of days. Instead, focus on what can give you the most secure footing: regular exercise, light meals and regular sleeping hours. Take care of yourself!

lucky.remedy: Place a zero watt red bulb on the southern wall of your bedroom and bring happiness to your family

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: All the loose ends in your life need to be tied up -- before you trip on them!
